1. From your Kali Linux VM, connect to the remote MSSQL instance on VM 2 and replicate the steps to enumerate the MSSQL database. Then explore the records of the sysusers table inside the master database. What is the value of the first user listed?

impacket-mssqlclient Administrator:Lab123@192.168.203.18 -windows-auth

select @@version;

select name from sys.databases;

select * from offsec.information_schema.tables;

select * from offsec.dbo.users;

show databases;

use sys

show tables;

select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'sys';

desc users;

select table_schema, table_name from information_schema.tables where table_name ='users';
